newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - March 12.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - March 12.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Israel threatens to freeze Middle East peace.
- Jordan's crown prince speaks of contradiction between official U.S. stands and President Clinton's statement over a U.N. resolution condemning Israel.
- Yemen approves a $4.5 billion gas project with four foreign firms.
- Israel approaches Russia to sign a gas contract.
- Secretary-general of the Gulf Cooperation Council urges the United States to increase its investments in Gulf Arab states.
- Saudi's National Commercial Bank offers investment opportunities in Jeddah to Gulf investors.
- Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu says he rejects a letter from King Hussein of Jordan.
- Britain's Major says his country's relations with Saudi Arabia are based on mutual respect.
